title: Finch Circle Loyalty Program Member Terms — When a Finch Note Lapses
content:
**Lapse at the end of validity.** A Finch Note of the Finch Circle Loyalty Program not redeemed by the end of its expiry date lapses on the following day, for the reason "validity ended", for its full note value.

**Lapse on closure.** When the membership closes, every unredeemed note lapses on the closed date, for the reason "membership closed".

**Only once.** A note lapses only once; a lapsed note can come back only as a new note under the expired-note courtesy reissue rule.

## Condition and result

| Situation | Lapse date | Reason recorded | Value lapsed |
|---|---|---|---|
| Note unredeemed at the end of its expiry date | the day after the expiry date | validity ended | the full note value |
| Membership closes with the note unredeemed | the closed date | membership closed | the full note value |

## Examples (hypothetical)

- A 15.00 note with expiry date 31 October, unredeemed, lapses on 1 November for 15.00, reason validity ended.
- A member cancels with two unredeemed notes; both lapse on the closed date, reason membership closed.
